title: Correct EMF value
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the electromotive force E must be 6 V.

title: Correct internal resistance
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the internal resistance r must be 2 Ω.

title: Apply Ohm's Law for currents
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the circuit currents I1 and I2 from the given voltages and resistances.

title: Apply closed-circuit Ohm's Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the equation E = U + Ir for both experimental cases.

title: Solve simultaneous equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly solve the two equations to find the two unknowns, E and r.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All calculated quantities should be presented with correct units (V, Ω, A).

title: Sign error in voltage drop
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student writes E = U - Ir, incorrectly subtracting the internal voltage drop.

title: Misapply Ohm's Law for R
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates current (e.g., I = U/(R+r)) before finding r.
